scenes.text: Multiples appear when you count by a number. The least common multiple is the first shared positive multiple.
Find LCM(12, 6). The answer is 12. Least common multiple equals 12.
Two bells in a craft workshop ring every 8 and 5 minutes. After how many minutes will they ring together? Pause to choose and explain.
Two bells in a craft workshop ring every 8 and 5 minutes. After how many minutes will they ring together? The answer is 40. Least common multiple equals 40.
